newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady on lower dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady on lower dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended mostly steady at 42.5050/5250 to the dollar in a dull interbank session against the previous 42.5000/5300, dealers said.

The taka was quoted at 42.5100/5300 per dollar in early trade but edged up later on lower demand for the greenback. "The market was very dull as most international markets were closed for the weekend," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended at 7.0 percent to 7.5 percent against 7.25 to 7.5 percent previously. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
